Why Sift Uses Notification Access
Targeted News Radar Alerts
Alerts you in real time when new intelligence matches your custom keyword traps (e.g., \'Semiconductor\', \'Fed Rate\').
Scheduled Morning Audio Briefing
Delivers your daily 3-minute executive digest at your selected hour so you stay informed without web clutter.
100% Zero-Spam Guarantee
We NEVER send clickbait, promotions, advertisements, or tracking pings. Only strictly vetted high-SNR news.
On-Device Privacy First
All keyword matching and notification schedules execute entirely locally on your phone via encrypted Room storage.
